name: ai-construction-os
description: AI-powered Architecture, Engineering & Construction Operating System
author: AI COS

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:python"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:web
scripts.test: cd backend && npm test && cd ../frontend && npm test
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../frontend && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../web && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.lint: cd frontend && npm run lint && cd ../backend && npm run lint
scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../python-services && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.deploy:backend: cd backend && npm run build && docker compose build backend && docker compose up -d backend
